name: Covert Cups | 200mg Rosin Chocolate Treats | Toasted and Roasted
description:
Toasted and Roasted 200mg Hash Rosin Infused | 8x25mg

Spread the sweetness while getting Roasted & Toasted. Dreamy milk chocolate layered with hazelnuts and creamy hazelnut spread, leaving you in a cozy haze.

Take a bite out of the ordinary with our NEW MINI CUPS! Delicious and discrete, our MINI Cups are a great way to get high on the low. Each package comes with 8 MINI Cups totaling 200mg THC in each bag. Solventless rosin is used for infusing this product with a clean, full-bodied high and contains more of the beneficial cannabinoids and terpenes from the plants used for extraction.

Packing 25mg THC into each cup, this tasty treat is the perfect pick-me up, specially packaged to microdose your experience.
